author: Forbes
description:
While many legacy luxury manufacturers face a cooling market, Genesis is outpacing the competition. Following a record-breaking 2025 with over 80,000 units sold, the brand has now achieved 18 consecutive months of year-over-year growth. This trajectory is anchored in the "Son-nim" philosophy which calls for treating every consumer as an "honored guest," and a "value over volume" business model that prioritizes long-term brand health over short-term sales targets.

The cornerstone of this growth is an adaptable engineering roadmap. Rather than a singular focus on a single technology, Genesis is selectively applying four distinct powertrains—ICE, Hybrid, eRev, and BEV—to meet customers exactly where they are in their journey to electrification. This flexibility is combined with a bold expansion into the performance sector via the Magma line, which uses synthetic torque curves and audio feedback to replicate the tactile thrill of a high-performance gas engine in an electric vehicle.

title: Record Growth: How Genesis Is Outpacing The Luxury Market | Cars & Bikes | Forbes
